packageRules.description: @nuxt/test-utils peer-requires vitest ^4. Release the ceiling once it supports vitest 5.
typescript-eslint peer-requires typescript <6.1 and vue-tsc needs the JS compiler API. Release the ceiling once both support TS 7.
h3 must match the version Nitro 2 bundles (^1); the test stubs use it as the real Nitro runtime. Release the ceiling when moving to Nitro 3.
